card.name: Opioid overdose reversal and controlled-substance wording
card.fires_on: Words just before or at naloxone/naltrexone in opioid labels, and the word "a" or "prescribing" in stock opioid warning sentences. It marks spots where a set phrase about overdose reversal or a Schedule II drug is about to continue.

modes.label: Schedule drug appositive
modes.description: The word "a" after the drug name in "contains morphine, a Schedule II controlled substance".
modes.example: Morphine Sulfate Oral Solution contains morphine,<< a>> Schedule II controlled substance.
